Brainstorms, session logs, analyses, post drafts, half-formed ideas. Allowed to be messy.** The Journal is the accumulation layer. When a session ends, it gets logged here. When a brainstorm happens, it goes here. When a lesson is learned, it goes here. Research that might eventually influence a section page starts here as a brainstorm and gets merged into the section page when it crystallises. --- # Entry types
Type When to use
**session** End of a working session (Claude Code or Claude chat)
**session-checkpoint** Mid-session save point for long sessions
**brainstorm** Exploratory thinking, research, analysis
**course-correction** Lesson learned, mistake documented
**risk** Risk or concern to track
**decision-context** Background context that explains a decision in the Decisions DB
--- # Views - **Active** — open entries only (Reviewed = unchecked) - **Needs Review** — entries older than 7 days that haven't been reviewed - **By Feature** — grouped by Related Feature - **Full Log** — everything, sorted by date --- # The Journal Journal "}
